settings.repere: Texte · How exactly does Buckley reduce allergen
settings.text: How exactly does Buckley reduce allergens?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Buckley uses a specific protein derived
settings.text: Buckley uses a specific protein derived from eggs (IgY) that naturally targets and neutralizes the Fel d 1 protein in your cat’s saliva. By neutralizing the allergen in the mouth, we prevent it from spreading to the fur during grooming, stopping the problem before it becomes airborne in your home.

settings.repere: Texte · Will my picky cat actually eat this?
settings.text: Will my picky cat actually eat this?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes. Buckley is completely flavorless an
settings.text: Yes. Buckley is completely flavorless and odorless. It is designed to blend seamlessly with wet, dry, or raw food without altering the taste or texture. Even the most finicky eaters won't know it's there.

settings.repere: Texte · Is it safe for kittens or cats with heal
settings.text: Is it safe for kittens or cats with health conditions?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes, but we recommend that you check wit
settings.text: Yes, but we recommend that you check with your veterinarian first. Buckley is a non-medicated, food-based supplement made from one simple ingredient: egg yolk. It's safe for cats of all breeds and ages. We always recommend starting with a small dose and gradually increasing as your cat adjusts. In rare cases, some cats may have egg sensitivities, so if you have any concerns, your veterinarian is always the best resource.

settings.text: While Buckley starts neutralizing allergens immediately upon consumption, it takes weeks to see the full effects. Most pet parents notice a significant improvement in symptoms within 4 weeks of daily use.

settings.text: We offer a risk-free 60-Day Money-Back Guarantee. If you don’t feel a difference in your allergy symptoms after giving it a fair try (we recommend at least 6 weeks), simply contact us at trybuckley@gmail.com for a full refund!

settings.text: What happens if I miss a day?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Consistency is crucial because your cat
settings.text: Consistency is crucial because your cat produces saliva (and allergens) constantly. If you miss a day, just resume the daily scoop as soon as possible to get back on track.

settings.repere: Texte · Does it contain grain, soy, or artificia
settings.text: Does it contain grain, soy, or artificial additives?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · No. Buckley is a clean-label product. We
settings.text: No. Buckley is a clean-label product. We use only essential, high-quality ingredients derived from pasture raised eggs.
